notes:
The collector's update!
New: Rarity Shifters - turn one copy of a card into a higher rarity and mix and match your copies (Shop > Items, or from pack milestones). Pick which rarity each copy shows in a deck; your opponent sees the foil too. Cosmetic: shifted copies still sell for their own price.
New: rest the mouse on a card in Database, Deck Builder or Collection for an info card with its art, price, stats and text.
New: archetypes as art tiles - in Statistics, the Database's new Archetypes browser and Manage Archetypes. Click one to see its cards.
New: pick the part of a picture that shows for your Home background, greeting image, Field Spell backgrounds and deck tiles.
New: premium sleeves and avatars can carry rarity foils, and the duel timer can count down to a loss.
New: a Resolve button and a quicker chain wait, an unobtrusive Respond chip, battle forecasts, Undo (Ctrl+Z), deck peeks on hover and trade value checks.
New: duels look better - attack trails in each Attribute's style, seven new signature card effects, LP bars, breathing monsters, drifting Field Spells, win streak flames and sleeves that react.
New: packs hint at good pulls face-down, Flip All flips in a wave and auto-sold dupes cash in as coins. Collection shows playset pips, Mastered sets and when you first pulled a card. Decks you play a lot glow.
New: colored splash text (Minecraft codes work in your greeting too), themed tooltips, rolling numbers and wobbling sidebar icons.
Faster: the app opens in about half the time. If it ever crashes, it offers to make a report for you.
Fixes: the collapsed sidebar is centered, the hand odds buttons have icons, drag previews sit under the mouse, and card details you record are no longer lost on restart.
